decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The access doorways to the two shop fronts shall have a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor.
Condition : 5 - The use of the temporary generators can only be used in conjunction with an acoustic screen to be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - The noise generated from the air handling units and refrigeration plant, should be inaudible when assessed from the closest flats at the junction of Dolman Road and Belmont Terrace and when assessed from Belmont Junior and Infant School.

Condition : 7 - The level of noise emitted from the air handling units and refrigeration plant, shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (Laeq), when measured from the closest flats at the junction of Dolman Road and Belmont Terrace and when measure from the closest fa?ade of Belmont Junior and Infants School, measured over any 24 hour period.
description: Installation of new shop front, new plant to the existing flat roof and new louvres.
